issues.span: They will make much more stored-up goodness from that.
issues.evidence: The segment is a comparison: the verse-keeper produces much more merit than the bodhisattva who fills immeasurable world systems with the seven precious substances and gives them as a gift. The children's text presents two separate 'think of' scenes and never says the goodness is greater than that of the gift; 'from that' only points to the verse.
issues.fix: They will make much more stored-up goodness than the hero who gave all those gifts. It will be countless and cannot be measured.

issues.evidence: Tibetan shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa is one locked term, 'perfect wisdom'; the extra 'this perfection' repeats it as if it were a second item.
